The '''[[Nilash III|Nilash]] natives''' were a [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-dwelling people and were noted for their inventiveness, spirit and the ability to form [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] group minds. This species was enslaved by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Daiman]] and forced to work in a [[Daimanate|Daimanite]] munitions factory, however they were liberated by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] shortly after the [[Destruction of Chelloa]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].

==Society and culture==
The natives of Nilash III possessed inventiveness and spirit, qualities which were described as "inspiring" by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]], and had an ability to form telepathic group minds, which Treece found "remarkable".<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" /> They were adept at hiding in jungle terrain, which allowed them to hide from their former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] overseers.<ref name="Aflame, Part 5" />

==History==
[[File:Lord_Daiman.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Lord Daiman, under whose rule the Nilash III species was enslaved.]]
At some point before or during the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Ithor Outreach]] carried out [[Sentientologist|anthropological]] studies on these [[Species/Legends|species]] and reported their findings in narratives.<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

Later, during the [[Second Charge Matrica|conflict]] between [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]] [[Daiman]] and [[Odion]], the species' home planet became a part of Daiman's [[Daimanate|territory]] and housed a munitions factory where the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] natives were forced to work.<ref name="Aflame, Part 5" /><ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

[[File:Vannar_Treece.jpg|150px|thumb|left|Vannar Treece, who was impressed by the native species.]]

Shortly before the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Operation Influx]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] compiled a report for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Genarra]] on the worlds of the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] and included in it a brief description of Nilash III and its natives, which was based upon the narratives of the Ithor Outreach.<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />
{{Quote|Someone entered the munitions plant and freed the native workers last night. We believe the slaves simply melted back into the jungle.|[[Uleeta]]|<ref name="Aflame, Part 5" />}}
After the disastrous Jedi mission<ref name="Aflame, Part 1">[[Knight Errant 1|''Knight Errant'' 1]]</ref> and the subsequent [[Destruction of Chelloa|devastation]] of the [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]]-rich Daimanite planet [[Chelloa]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] visited Nilash and freed the native slave workers, who disappeared in the surrounding jungle.<ref name="Aflame, Part 5" />

[[File:Kerra_Holt.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Kerra Holt, who liberated the native slave workers.]]
